groups.interpretation: Frozen slotted entry holds geometry tuple, span and nullable extrema; no deep immutability or validation by annotations.

Initialize independent empty lists and sets for bullish then bearish; invoke actual update with dirty zero. Constructor ignores returned tuple but metadata side effects occur. No constructor rollback.

Validate chained inclusive 0<=dirty<=len(main) with short circuit; negative avoids length read. Invalid raises before local entry building. Equality len permitted; no integer-type or dataset-generation check.
Create new temporary entry and changed mappings; iterate retained direction mapping order, then enumerate supplied native reaction list zero-based; no local sorting.

Key field order First, Break, intrabar_start, str(top), top source index, str(bottom), bottom source index. Only price strings distinguish Decimal representations; nonstring tuple fields use native equality, no object identity/time generation or metadata in key.

Look up same ordinal only when position < previous list length. Reuse exact entry iff old nonnull, geometry equal, Break strictly before dirty; equal dirty rebuilds. Short circuit in order. Retained entry may be stale if caller dirty frontier incoherent.

Build published/native span then eagerly compute path extremes even without outer owners. Construct new entry; mark position changed only on full dataclass inequality (geometry, span, extrema; Decimal numeric equality there). Append rebuilt entry even if equal to old. Recomputed does not imply changed.
Build new matches and blocked mappings. For each inner direction resolve opposite then retrieve both changed-position sets; no mutation of retained maps yet.

Retain prior pairs when inner index < current inner length AND inner not changed AND outer index < current outer length AND outer not changed, in that order. No lower bound check on stored positions; native pairs are nonnegative enumeration indices. Removed tail filtered, same-ordinal replacement depends on changed detection.

Enumerate all inner entries; changed inner scans all current outer positions in range order, unchanged inner scans only outer_changed set in set iteration order, not a chronological rank. Read outer span at selected ordinal.

Evaluate outer may_contain first then contains_path on inner cached extrema. Strict outer First and inclusive confirmation/box/path boundaries from RE64/66. Add every passing pair, no first-owner break; None extrema cannot pass.

Store pair set and derive blocked physical identity set from inner span identities, not ordinal keys. Removing one owner does not unblock an inner if any valid pair remains; duplicate physical identities collapse. No canonical record deletion.

Materialize new span lists in current order then apply RE67 on supplied full objects. Metadata changes can partially escape if helper fails; prior maps still retained, earlier chronology/index effects not rolled back.
Only after successful metadata application replace both retained mappings and return helper result. Not an atomic transaction covering external aliases.
Validate requested direction membership in exact supported set before caches. Native hash/type error or unsupported ValueError propagates. No local market/range validation.

Derive opposite direction then choose exact bearish Order GREEN First/RED context else RED First/GREEN context; create separate closure-local candidate and detection caches. No generation or eviction.

Nested closure captures source sequences, tags, direction and caches. gate_event not read. Key (gate_index,end_index) checked by membership before any candle reads; return stored candidate reference or cached None.

Lazily scan ascending positions max(1,gate_index) through end inclusive, current tag before predecessor tag; first adjacent role pair wins, default None. No upper clamping or local input validation; source lookup/type failures propagate.
No eligible pair writes None in outer cache then returns; later identical key remains a hit despite any source mutation.

Context initialized first-1, extend backward through contiguous matching context tag while context>0, checking bound before predecessor; can reach zero or precede gate. Detection key context/end, not exact event or gate.

Retrieve cached detection tuple or empty tuple; select first stored reaction in tuple order whose required First int conversion >= gate, equality accepted. No confirmation time or Break check here; conversion failures propagate.

Only when selected order None construct Unified from captured sources, context to end, opposite direction, default trend flags; detect with First threshold gate. Tuple materialization then replace detection cache before subsequent selection. No runtime proof of bounded detector success.
Search fresh tuple in returned order using same required int First>=gate. Failure here may leave newly replaced detection cache while outer key remains absent; no rollback.

Store selected Candidate or None by reference under gate/end and return; factory returns closure. No clone, exact-event acceptance, invalidation, eviction or canonical Order creation; consuming owner performs distinct admission.

supplemental.historical: Frozen entry stores geometry/span/extremes; initialize empty entries and matches both directions, then perform actual update dirty zero. Constructor ignores returned result but update mutates supplied metadata.

Dirty boundary inclusive [0,len(main)]. Entry reuse requires same ordinal, exact tuple (First, Break, intrabar, str top, top source index, str bottom, bottom source index) and Break<dirty. Recompute span and path even without owners, changed only when new entry !=old; removed tails eliminated by pair bounds. No general input mutation validation.

Keep surviving pairs only when both unchanged; changed inner scans all current opposite owners, unchanged inner scans only changed outer set. Every successful pair retained, not just first. Blocked physical identity survives removal of one owner if another remains. Set iteration order not a chronological ranking.

Build span lists, apply metadata to existing full native objects, then assign entries/matches; no clone in this stage and no explicit rollback if metadata application partially fails. Cached pair positions distinct from physical identities.
Validate requested direction, derive opposite direction/tags, allocate closure-local caches. gate_event parameter is not read in body; caller owns exact time acceptance.
Key gate/end caches both candidate reference and null. Scan current tags from max(1,gate) inclusive; stop first matching adjacent pair, extend context backward through contiguous same tag to zero.

Detection cache keyed context/end. Cached tuple searched for first First>=gate; absent triggers fresh bounded Unified scan with stop threshold gate, replaces tuple, then searches again. Cache order result unchanged by reference, no clone, no exact-event verification, no automatic invalidation.

decision_order: ordinal reuse else rebuild and full equality changed test
changed inner/all outer or unchanged inner/changed outer
all passing pairs -> blocked physical identity
metadata application before retained maps assignment
ascending adjacent role pair and backward context
cached tuple first First>=gate else detector and cache replacement before selection
outer cache stores candidate or None

findings.meaning: Clarify RE69–72 and CV01/CV02: dirty validation, exact key and full entry comparison, ordinal pair retention versus physical identities, metadata failure boundary, closure cache replacement and exact event/caller admission. Historical B02-07-F01–F03 retained.

limitations: Local source semantics, not runtime equivalence or global cache safety. Caller dirty correctness and conditional dispatch remain open.
Four synthetic comprehension filter IDs are matched by exact W1 crosswalk span, not numeric AST node lookup.
remaining: B02 1617–2908 and B03–B10 local and cross-owner review.
